verdict.rationale: No evidence of any public API at all—probes for llms.txt, docs-md, and OpenAPI specs all returned 404, and no docs mention an API. Clerky's evidence is entirely about UI-based workflows (document sets, tasks, bank applications), with no mechanism for programmatic/API access to any of these features. Missing for 10: any documented API, SDK, or programmatic interface for even basic operations.
